'''Malor Phiatt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] Special Agent during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In contact with the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Kilmera Skale/Legends|Kilmera Skale]], Phiatt sent representatives to accept a gift of several [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] slaves from Skale.<ref name="EV" />
